text: Voting for the student council will be held on 18 November from 9 AM to 5 PM in the Student Center. Bring your student ID.

subject: Blood donation drive on Thursday
text: A blood donation drive is being held on Thursday from 9 AM to 4 PM at the Student Center. All donors are welcome.

subject: Red Cross blood donation camp
text: The Red Cross unit is organising a blood donation camp on 5 November at the health centre. Register at https://vit.ac.in/redcross.

subject: Semester registration opens 1 November
text: Semester registration for Winter 2026-27 opens on 1 November at https://vtop.vit.ac.in/registration and closes on 10 November. Contact your proctor if you need help.

subject: Course registration window open
text: The course registration window is open until 12 November. Review the official instructions at https://vit.ac.in/registration. No fee is charged for registration.

subject: VTOP password reset requested
text: A password reset was requested for your VTOP account. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, contact helpdesk@vit.ac.in. We will never ask for your password by email.

subject: Your VIT password was changed
text: Your VIT password was changed successfully. If you did not make this change, call the IT Helpdesk on the number listed at https://vit.ac.in/helpdesk.

subject: Fee refund credited
text: A fee refund of Rs 3,200 has been credited to the bank account on record. No action is required. Contact finance@vit.ac.in for queries.

subject: Semester fee refund processed
text: Your semester fee refund has been processed. Check your bank statement. VIT will never ask for your bank password or OTP.

subject: Internship offer available on the PAT portal
text: Your internship offer letter is available on the PAT portal at https://pat.vit.ac.in/offers. Review the terms and confirm your joining date there.

subject: Infosys internship offer published
text: The Infosys internship offer is published at https://pat.vit.ac.in/internships. Read the terms and contact placement@vit.ac.in for questions.

subject: Library fine payment received
text: Your library fine payment of Rs 240 has been received. The receipt is available at https://library.vit.ac.in/receipts.

subject: Library dues cleared
text: Library dues cleared. Download the receipt from https://library.vit.ac.in/account. No further payment is needed.

subject: Hostel electricity bill for October
text: The hostel electricity bill for October is available on the hostel portal at https://hostel.vit.ac.in/bills. Pay through the official portal before 30 November.

subject: Hostel electricity balance sufficient
text: Your hostel electricity balance is sufficient. Check the statement at https://hostel.vit.ac.in/utilities. No action is required.

subject: Revaluation window for FAT
text: The revaluation window for FAT is open until 20 November. Apply at https://vit.ac.in/revaluation. The fee is paid through the official portal.

subject: Revaluation results published
text: Revaluation results are published at https://vtop.vit.ac.in/results. Contact coe@vit.ac.in if you see a discrepancy.

subject: Convocation 2026 registration open
text: Convocation 2026 registration is open at https://vit.ac.in/convocation until 30 November. Guest passes can be requested on the same page.

subject: Convocation gown fee
text: The convocation gown fee is payable at the official counter or via https://vit.ac.in/convocation-fee. No payment is collected by email.

subject: Alumni fund receipt
text: Thank you for your contribution to the alumni fund. Your receipt is available at https://alumni.vit.ac.in/receipts.

subject: Alumni donation recorded
text: Your alumni donation has been recorded. Download the receipt from https://alumni.vit.ac.in/account. Contact alumni@vit.ac.in for corrections.

subject: Merit scholarship interview schedule
text: You are shortlisted for the merit scholarship interview on 18 November at 10 AM in Academic Block 2. Confirm your slot at https://vit.ac.in/scholarship-interview.

subject: Scholarship interview slot
text: Check your scholarship interview slot at https://vit.ac.in/scholarship-slots. Bring your student ID and income certificate.

subject: Verify your resume on the PAT portal
text: Placement Cell: please verify your resume details on the PAT portal at https://pat.vit.ac.in/profile before the Infosys drive.

subject: Update your resume for recruiters
text: Your resume is visible to recruiters. Update your CGPA and skills at https://pat.vit.ac.in/profile. Contact pat@vit.ac.in for help.

subject: Microsoft 365 mailbox at 80 percent
text: Your Microsoft 365 mailbox is 80 percent full. Review large attachments at https://outlook.office.com/mail. No action is required unless you need more space.

subject: Microsoft 365 storage notice
text: Your mailbox is near its quota. Archive old mail at https://outlook.office.com. IT will never ask for your password.

subject: File shared with you: CS302 notes
text: A file 'CS302_notes.pdf' has been shared with you by prof.kumar@vit.ac.in. Open it at https://drive.google.com.

subject: Your professor shared a lab manual
text: Your professor shared 'Lab_manual.pdf' on Google Drive. View it at https://drive.google.com/drive. Check the sender before opening any file.

subject: Added to the CS302 course group
text: You have been added to the CS302 course WhatsApp group by the class representative. The group is for timetable updates only.

subject: Placement group for the 2027 batch
text: The placement group for the 2027 batch is on WhatsApp. Ask your class representative to add you; no payment is required.

subject: Official Placement Cell Telegram channel
text: The Placement Cell runs an official Telegram channel for drive updates: https://t.me/vitplacements. No fee is charged to join.

subject: VIT exam updates channel
text: Join the official VIT exam updates channel at https://t.me/vitexams. Verify announcements on the VIT website.

subject: Student directory photo
text: The student directory uses your ID-card photo. If you want a different photo, submit it at https://vit.ac.in/student-directory by 30 November.

subject: Profile photo renewal
text: Your profile photo is due for renewal. Upload a new photo at https://vit.ac.in/profile-photo. This is optional.

subject: VIT ranked among the top institutions
text: VIT has been ranked among the top institutions in the latest national ranking. Read the official announcement at https://vit.ac.in/rankings.

subject: Ranking report available
text: The ranking report is available at https://vit.ac.in/rankings/report. No login or payment is required.

subject: Student grievance portal
text: The student grievance portal is available at https://vit.ac.in/grievance. Submit a complaint with your roll number; no password is required.

subject: Grievance status
text: A grievance you filed is under review. Check the status at https://vit.ac.in/grievance/status using your ticket number.

subject: Reserved book ready for collection
text: Your reserved book is ready for collection at the central library. The reservation fee is Rs 50, payable at the counter.

subject: Library reservation confirmed
text: Library reservation confirmed for 'Operating System Concepts'. Collect it by Friday; no online payment is needed.

subject: Mess feedback for November
text: Mess feedback for November is open at https://hostel.vit.ac.in/mess-feedback until 5 November. Your responses are anonymous.

subject: Complete the mess feedback form
text: Please complete the mess feedback form at https://hostel.vit.ac.in/feedback. It takes two minutes and helps improve the menu.

subject: Your bus pass QR
text: Your bus pass QR is available in the transport portal at https://vit.ac.in/transport-pass. Show it to the conductor; no payment is collected by email.

subject: Bus pass renewal for Route 14
text: Bus pass renewal for Route 14 is open at https://vit.ac.in/bus-pass until 30 November. Pay at the transport office.

subject: ID card renewal for the 2026 batch
text: ID card renewal for the 2026 batch is open at https://vit.ac.in/id-card. Bring your old card to the student office.

subject: Your ID card is due for renewal
text: Upload a photo at https://vit.ac.in/id-card/photo and collect the new card from the student office.

subject: Course completion certificate
text: Your course completion certificate is available at https://vit.ac.in/certificates. Download it with your VTOP login.

subject: NPTEL course certificates ready
text: Certificates for the NPTEL course are ready. Collect them from the department office or download at https://vit.ac.in/certificates.

subject: NPTEL exam registration closes 20 November
text: NPTEL exam registration closes on 20 November. Register at https://nptel.ac.in and pay the official fee on the NPTEL site.

subject: NPTEL exam centre list
text: The NPTEL exam centre list is published at https://vit.ac.in/nptel. Check your centre and carry your hall ticket.

subject: Upload your joining documents
text: Please upload your joining documents (PAN, bank details) to the secure HR portal at https://hr.vit.ac.in/onboarding. Do not send them by email.

subject: Internship onboarding incomplete
text: Your internship onboarding is incomplete. Upload the documents at https://pat.vit.ac.in/onboarding before 10 November.

subject: Update your student record
text: The Dean's office is updating student records. Confirm your roll number and programme at https://vit.ac.in/records before 30 November.

subject: Verify your academic record
text: Please verify your academic record at https://vtop.vit.ac.in/profile. Contact your proctor if anything is incorrect.

subject: Remote support session scheduled
text: The IT Helpdesk has scheduled a remote support session for your ticket. Join through the official link at https://vit.ac.in/helpdesk/session using your ticket number.

subject: Your VTOP login issue is being investigated
text: The technician will contact you through the ticket at https://vit.ac.in/helpdesk. Never share your password.

subject: Campus emergency drill on Friday
text: A campus emergency drill will be held on Friday at 11 AM. Follow the wardens' instructions. The control room number is 0416-2202020.

subject: Annual fire drill
text: The annual fire drill is on 12 November at 3 PM. No action is required before the drill; listen for the announcement.

subject: Scholarship refund transferred
text: Your scholarship refund of Rs 5,000 has been transferred to the bank account on record. No further action is needed. Contact scholarships@vit.ac.in for queries.

subject: Scholarship disbursement complete
text: The scholarship disbursement for this semester is complete. Check your bank statement; VIT will never ask for your UPI PIN.

subject: FAT hall ticket available
text: Your FAT hall ticket is available at https://vtop.vit.ac.in/hallticket. Download it with your VTOP login and check the exam centre.

subject: Hall tickets for the FAT
text: Hall tickets for the FAT are published. Download yours at https://vtop.vit.ac.in/hallticket. Contact coe@vit.ac.in for corrections.

subject: Your VTOP session expired
text: Your VTOP session expired due to inactivity. Log in again at https://vtop.vit.ac.in. No password reset is needed.

subject: VTOP sessions expire after 30 minutes
text: For security, VTOP sessions expire after 30 minutes. Log in at https://vtop.vit.ac.in to continue. Contact helpdesk@vit.ac.in if you have trouble.
